name: seth
description: SETH (Social-Enterprise Technical Handler) — executes MOCA, the Mission Opportunity–Constraint Architecture (Lahtee 2026). Loads before analyzing, diagnosing, or simulating any social enterprise: viability gates, mission drift vs. authorized hardship rules, the four benchmarks and the O_M − C_M identity, binding architecture per mission locus, obligation-stock dynamics, readout-bounded impact-claim audits, and prediction-freeze falsification. Missing is NI, never zero.
